locations.note: Task Force 141 chases arms dealer Rojas through Rio's favelas.
Private Allen's opening patrol and the final hunt for Shepherd both take place in Afghanistan.
Army Rangers fight to retake the capital, including the White House, from Russian invaders.
Task Force 141 frees hostages on an oil rig off Kamchatka, storms the gulag near Petropavlovsk to free Prisoner 627, Price, and then fights through to a submarine base to launch a nuclear missile.
Loose Ends: Task Force 141 raids Makarov's safehouse on the Georgian–Russian border for his files, and Shepherd shoots Roach and Ghost at the extraction.
Roach and Soap climb an ice cliff in the Tian Shan mountains to steal a module from a Russian airbase.
The Zakhaev Airport massacre in Moscow triggers the war that drives the campaign.
Rangers hold defensive lines in Northern Virginia suburbs against the Russian invasion.

routes.name: PFC Joseph Allen
routes.note: From a Ranger patrol in Afghanistan to deep cover with Makarov at Zakhaev Airport, where he is left dead to frame America.

routes.name: Task Force 141
routes.note: From a satellite module stolen in the Tian Shan, through Rio's favelas, the oil rig, gulag and submarine base in Kamchatka and Makarov's Georgian safehouse, to the Afghan boneyard where Shepherd dies.

routes.name: Pvt. James Ramirez
routes.note: Rangers fall back from the Northern Virginia suburbs to a last stand in a burning Washington.
